01

Brand Essence

Molecular biology, translated into operational certainty for the insect industry.

Cucare Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics and CRO spin-off of the University of Valencia, built on insect science. We pair academic rigor with the responsiveness of an agile lab — serving rearing facilities, feed producers, agrochemical companies and applied researchers across Europe.

Every visual decision in this system reflects that balance: precise like a protocol, warm like a partner who picks up the phone.

Precise Rigorous Approachable Modern Scientific Collaborative
Sector
Molecular diagnostics & CRO services — insect science
Audience
Insect rearing facilities · feed producers · agrochemical companies · applied researchers
Personality
Authoritative, yet approachable
Tone of Voice
Professional · trustworthy · modern scientific
02

Logo System

Primary — on white / light backgrounds
Reversed — on navy / dark backgrounds
Clear space — min. height of the "c" on all sides
Icon mark — for favicons & small formats
Minimum width: 28 mm print / 120 px digital
Minimum size
✓DO
  • Use on white or very light backgrounds
  • Use the reversed version on navy / dark surfaces
  • Maintain generous clear space around the mark
  • Scale proportionally, always
✗DON'T
  • Recolor, distort, stretch or rotate the logo
  • Add shadows, outlines or other effects
  • Separate or recompose the icon and wordmark
  • Place on low-contrast or busy backgrounds

Color Palette

Primary colors carry brand recognition; secondary tones add warmth to figures and information panels. White remains the dominant ground — the palette is built to breathe.

05

Graphic Language

A biomorphic vocabulary grown from the logo's own waveform: soft, organic forms balanced by precise scientific structure. Decoration concentrates in one or two corners — never centered, never symmetrical.
Layered biomorphic blobs · 40–70% opacity
Dot grid overlay · 10–15% opacity
Diagonal line texture · subtle accent
Waveform motif, repeated — an optional divider between sections
